children: AST SpaceMobile plans to build its reusable 20-ton Blacklift rocket, aiming to launch up to five BlueBird satellites per flight starting in late 2028.
Blacklift will use Firefly Miranda and Vira engines, with a perpetual license for AST SpaceMobile to manufacture them.
The license agreement includes about $800 million upfront: $400 million cash and 10 million to 14 million Class A shares.
AST SpaceMobile will pay $250 million for engines for the first three rockets and $250 million for three years of engineering support.
External launch agreements cover more than 100 BlueBird satellites expected to deploy cumulatively in 2027 and 2028.

title: AST SpaceMobile Plans Blacklift Rocket, Commits $1.3 Billion to Firefly Agreements
